name: meridian-airport-retail-media-platform
description: Airport Retail Media Platform: Ads and promotions on airport screens triggered by live flight and passenger-flow data (Topcoder Challenge)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
